mapper.sql: case when coalesce(st.available_quantity, k.available_stock, 0) <= 0 then 'OUT_OF_STOCK' when coalesce(st.available_quantity, k.available_stock, 0) <= coalesce(st.warning_threshold, 0) then 'LOW_STOCK' else 'HEALTHY' end
mapper.select: select s.spu_id,s.spu_code,s.product_name,s.subtitle,s.main_image,c.category_name,b.brand_name,s.publish_status from mall_spu s join mall_category c on c.category_id=s.category_id and c.del_flag='0' left join mall_brand b on b.brand_id=s.brand_id and b.del_flag='0' where s.spu_id=#{spuId} and s.del_flag='0'

select k.sku_id,k.spu_id,k.sku_code,k.sku_name,k.spec_json,k.price,k.status, coalesce(st.available_quantity,k.available_stock,0) available_quantity, coalesce(st.locked_quantity,0) locked_quantity,coalesce(st.sold_quantity,0) sold_quantity, coalesce(st.warning_threshold,0) warning_threshold, stock_status, coalesce(st.update_time,k.update_time) update_time from mall_sku k left join mall_stock st on st.sku_id=k.sku_id where k.spu_id=#{spuId} and k.del_flag='0' order by k.sku_id
